purpose: Resolve the authoritative configuration names and solar-wing angles BEFORE building any G2 configuration. Per the work order section 8, angles must be read from an authority -- never guessed from appearance or screenshots.

primary_authority.representation_invariant: Never resolve B601 HIFI and q0 proxy simultaneously; never suppress both in a state that claims an arm representation.

native_solidworks_at_source.note: Confirms the SSOT itself had NO native SW configurations -- consistent with defect D-F3R1-04. G2 is the first native realisation.

secondary_authority.used_for: SOLAR_DEPLOY_ARM_LOCKED and SOLAR_DEPLOYED_ARM_RELEASED state semantics (hdrm_state / solar_state columns); it carries NO wing angle values (all arm/gripper vectors are TBD).

corroborating_doc.note: Section 3 '七态构型合同' reproduces the same 7 states and angles and states explicitly that later native CAD with同名 configurations must NOT override these semantics.

naming_decision.rule_applied: Work order section 6: if a unique authoritative list exists, reuse its names verbatim.
naming_decision.finding: The SSOT defines SEVEN states, not eight. The work order's default 8-item list differs from the SSOT in two ways: it adds SOLAR_DEPLOY_ARM_LOCKED (which exists in the B5_0 secondary matrix), and it renames STOWED to STOWED_ENGINEERING_CANDIDATE.
naming_decision.resolution: Keep all 7 SSOT names as the spine. Add SOLAR_DEPLOY_ARM_LOCKED from the secondary authority to reach 8, because the work order requires that state and the frozen sequence '太阳翼先展开 → B601 再释放' needs it. Realise SSOT 'STOWED' under the work order's explicit name STOWED_ENGINEERING_CANDIDATE and record the alias so the SSOT link is not lost.
naming_decision.not_done: No Configuration1 / Default-Copy / placeholder configurations are created.

configurations.name: STOWED_ENGINEERING_CANDIDATE
configurations.claim_limit: Engineering candidate only. NOT a runtime-compliant state, NOT a SAFE-00 execution entry. q_stow remains provisional; rebuildability does NOT upgrade it.

configurations.name: SOLAR_DEPLOY_ARM_LOCKED
configurations.angle_source: state_policy.json/DEPLOYED_NOMINAL end-state angles; the TRANSIT path itself is not authorised
configurations.ssot_status: HOLD (secondary matrix: 'Static staging evidence only; full top-level sweep missing')
configurations.claim_limit: Expresses solar wings deployed while B601 stays LOCKED and ARM HDRM is NOT released, per the frozen sequence 太阳翼先展开 → B601 再释放. Intermediate deploy angles are NOT authorised; only the locked-arm end state is represented.

configurations.name: DEPLOYED_NOMINAL
configurations.claim_limit: Named static pose only; NOT a global workspace or continuous-clearance proof.

configurations.name: L_FAIL
configurations.claim_limit: Static asymmetric scene only. Arm release must remain inhibited pending the state contract.

configurations.name: R_FAIL
configurations.claim_limit: Static asymmetric scene only. Arm release must remain inhibited.

configurations.name: DEPLOY_FAILED_BOTH
configurations.claim_limit: Static failure scene; gives NO failure probability or recovery authority. Arm release must remain inhibited.

configurations.name: PARTIAL
configurations.angle_source: NO AUTHORITY EXISTS -- state_policy.json records solar_left_deg=null / solar_right_deg=null and diagnostic_samples_define_partial=false, i.e. the 5/15/30/60 deg samples explicitly do NOT define PARTIAL. A first attempt wrote a 30 deg diagnostic sample; it did not persist because the G1 wing coincident mates hold the panels against the deck and SolidWorks re-solved them back to 90 deg. Rather than suppress those mates to force an unauthorised angle, the configuration is left geometrically UNDIFFERENTIATED from DEPLOYED and declared as such.
configurations.claim_limit: PARTIAL has NO authoritative wing angle and is NOT geometrically differentiated in G2: it currently renders identically to DEPLOYED_NOMINAL (90/90). The configuration name exists so the state is registered and addressable, but it must NOT be cited as a defined mission state, and its geometry must NOT be read as a partial-deployment scene. Differentiating it requires a ratified PARTIAL angle plus the G3 wing-root hinge interface.

configurations.name: SERVICE
configurations.angle_source: NO AUTHORITY EXISTS -- state_policy.json records null angles and PENDING_RATIFICATION_HOLD. The deployed 90/90 wing angle is reused so the scene is viewable; no service access sequence or service joint vector is authorised.
configurations.claim_limit: No access sequence, service joint vector, or native configuration is authorised. Wing angle is a viewing convenience under PROVISIONAL_HOLD, not a ratified service pose.

angle_convention.definition: 0 deg = stowed (panel folded against the bus, hanging in -Z per the STOWED donor part); 90 deg = deployed (panel extended outboard in the XY plane per the DEPLOYED donor part).
angle_convention.derived_from: The two donor panel parts themselves: WING_*_STOWED spans z[-200,0] at |y|~113-119 (folded down); WING_*_DEPLOYED spans z[-3,3] reaching |y| up to 313 (extended outboard). This matches state_policy 0 deg / 90 deg.

unresolved_holds_carried: D-F3R1-06 wing-root hinge interface remains OPEN: the panels sit at |y|=113.15 while the real hinge pins are at |y|=143.15 -- a ~30 mm gap. G2 angle mates are KINEMATIC_CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE only and do NOT close the physical hinge.
PARTIAL and SERVICE angles have no authority and stay PROVISIONAL_HOLD.
q_stow stays O13_V3_CANDIDATE_HOLD_PROVISIONAL; G2 must not upgrade it.
